digest.component_or_area: rebar LLM provider factory / runner config validation
propositions: _pai_check_config currently raises on any base_url/api_key even though config parsing and documentation already support them, making the docs false.

Register an openai provider builder that constructs OpenAIChatModel with OpenAIProvider(base_url,api_key), gated only when cfg.base_url is set so bare openai models keep the lazy model-string path and the openai SDK stays optional.
base_url is provider configuration, not selection; the provider is still chosen by the model string / REBAR_LLM_MODEL_PROVIDER, and base_url must not hijack an explicit anthropic provider selection.

The builder overrides the provider's model_profile to withdraw only supports_json_schema_output (set False) so an opaque OpenAI-compatible endpoint yields PromptedOutput instead of strict NativeOutput, while other capabilities like supports_tools remain unchanged.
_pai_check_config becomes validation: reject api_key without base_url, reject non-absolute base_url naming the variable, and send a placeholder key for no-auth local servers.

Document and pin the accidental behavior where a non-loopback ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL routes rebar through an Anthropic-wire gateway, and add pydantic-ai-slim[openai] to the dev extra only, leaving the agents runtime extra unchanged.
